summary: Implemented all 5 plan phases: sapience-publish.sh now exposes four dry-run-by-default write-surface subcommands (doc-comment, doc-version, dm, ko) routed through the shared sapience-api-lib.sh, each with loud-failure handling written against its own endpoint's verified response shape. Added a 53-case test suite, registered both new files in manifest.json and Case 30's lockstep array, and deployed both files with byte-identical confirmation against the source store. Found and fixed two reusable shell pitfalls along the way (a sapience_post HTTP-status subshell-loss hazard, and a redirection-order bug), both documented inline. verify-touched.sh reproduced the same 2 pre-existing/environmental test failures in both Phase 1 and Phase 5 runs, confirmed unrelated to this task's files.
